mods.name: FantasyMapGenerator
mods.description: Generates the overworld from an Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator JSON export.

releases.notes:
**NeoForge 1.21.1.** Download `fantasymapgenerator-1.1.0-neoforge-1.21.1.jar` below and put it in your `mods/` folder.

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21+
- [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) 21.1 (tested with 21.1.259)
- Vanilla content only (Conquest Reforged is 1.20.1 only). [WWOO](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo/) is recommended alongside it.

### Setup

- [Setting up a client (singleplayer)](https://github.com/Transfer-re/Azgaar_Minecraft_Converter/tree/neoforge-1.21.1#setting-up-a-client-singleplayer): export the map from FMG, then *Create New World* > *World Type: Fantasy Map* > *Customize*.
- [Setting up a server](https://github.com/Transfer-re/Azgaar_Minecraft_Converter/tree/neoforge-1.21.1#setting-up-a-server): create the world in singleplayer, then copy it over.
- [Commands](https://github.com/Transfer-re/Azgaar_Minecraft_Converter/tree/neoforge-1.21.1#commands) and [configuration](https://github.com/Transfer-re/Azgaar_Minecraft_Converter/tree/neoforge-1.21.1#configuration).

### What's new since 1.0.1

- **Customize screen** when creating a world: pick your FMG JSON with a file dialog and set the map scale, terrain mode, detail noise, biome variants and content. No more editing `config.json`.
- **Blended terrain**: eroded mountains and biome-shaped lowlands; the build height is raised automatically for tall mountains.
- **Rivers** carved into valleys, and **roads and trails** with bridges, along the map's rivers and routes.
- **Biome variants** per region, and a **village at every burg**.
- Vanilla 1.18-style **noise caves**.
- Each world is **prepared once** on first load and keeps its own copy of the map, so it is self-contained.
- **`/fmg export`** and **`/fmg heightmap`** for WorldPainter and other editors.
- Now built for Fabric 1.20.1, Forge 1.20.1, Fabric 1.21.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1; the Conquest Reforged content is 1.20.1 only, because Conquest Reforged is.

### Not yet tested on this loader

Worldgen was tested on a dedicated server and the client starts cleanly, but the Customize screen and `/fmg borders` have not been played on NeoForge yet. Please report anything odd.

- [Commands](https://github.com/Transfer-re/Azgaar_Minecraft_Converter/tree/forge-1.20.1#commands) and [configuration](https://github.com/Transfer-re/Azgaar_Minecraft_Converter/tree/forge-1.20.1#configuration).

### What's new since 1.0.1

- **Customize screen** when creating a world: pick your FMG JSON with a file dialog and set the map scale, terrain mode, detail noise, biome variants and content. No more editing `config.json`.
- **Blended terrain**: eroded mountains and biome-shaped lowlands; the build height is raised automatically for tall mountains.

- **Conquest Reforged content**: 29 Conquest biomes, layered ground from Conquest blocks, the project's own trees, and vanilla and modded structures in the Conquest biomes.
